items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’ve got a list here: ... George Duvivier. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. We had a thing for – a jingle for Volkswagen. Ten of us got out of a Volkswagen playing When the Saints go marching in, something like that. Snooky was driving the Volkswagen. It just drove like “Vrrrrrrrrr” and stopped, and we got out, and everybody’s playing. It was just to show how amazingly this area was. Ten cats could get out with instruments and playing. Everett Barksdale was one of the people who was on the gig. I was the contractor at the time, and Barksdale and I – after a while, there were…
I’ve got a list here: Milt Hinton, Jimmy Nottingham, Joe Wilder, Ernie Royal, Jerome Richardson, Thad Jones, Joe Newman, Hank Jones, George Duvivier.
